title: CenterDepth Stereo Fisheye Matching Benchmark
summary: A Python benchmark project for comparing stereo matching models on dual-fisheye camera data. It standardizes video decoding, PTS synchronization, fisheye epipolar rectification, and experiment statistics across WAFT, S2M2, LiteAnyStereo 2, Fast Foundation Stereo, StereoNet, and OpenCV baselines; the standard output is left-camera depth video, with optional bidirectional disparity and center-view RGB/metric-depth synthesis.

title: ZPDS Multi-source Data Cleaning and Standardization
summary: A Python pipeline for cleaning video and multi-source sensor data. It checks frame-count consistency, bad frames, timestamp gaps, depth/IMU/audio/action-signal anomalies, and image quality issues such as black frames, overexposure, blur, and camera shake; it also supports hand detection plus face and privacy masking before producing standardized segments for trimming, splitting, flagging, or review.

title: Zata Data Collection Platform Agent
summary: The intelligent agent of the data collection platform based on Hermes Agent realizes intelligent platform data management. Through MCP Tools, tasks and job maintenance are automated, and it supports operations by multiple roles such as administrators and collectors.

title: Personal Knowledge Wiki
summary: A personal knowledge base built with Next.js, featuring Markdown/MDX content authoring, bilingual support (zh/en), dark mode, static export, and automated GitHub Pages deployment.
